title: Crowd Management at Parks during COVID-19 Pandemic
what_it_is: Crowd Management at Parks during COVID-19 Pandemic

sections.label: NParks park crowd management
sections.summary: NParks monitors and controls park crowds, gives online updates, and takes measures to reduce disamenities to nearby residents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To actively manage visitor levels, the National Parks Board (NParks) carries out real-time crowd monitoring and control, and closes crowded parks or park areas for a period of time if needed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks also provides real-time updates on park visitor levels online via its Safe Distance@Parks portal so that visitors can check crowd levels before going to the parks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For popular parks that are located near residential areas, NParks has implemented measures to reduce potential disamenities to residents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: These include increasing patrols during peak periods and displaying signs to remind park users of proper park etiquette and regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Organised group activities are also not allowed during peak periods at selected parks to manage the visitor levels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks also works closely with other Government agencies and grassroots organisations where relevant, to address the residents' feedback.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks will continue to expand the network of parks, including nature parks, so that more Singaporeans can enjoy nature-based recreation.
